maria_sales: Morning — quick triage: two enterprise deals with security review outstanding. MacroHealth needs data residency confirmation; NovaGrid wants KMS/HSM proof. Docs repo says Private deploy guide updated last week. Who can own follow-ups? @elaine_security?

devon_ae: I can ping MacroHealth legal. Do we have a standard data residency blurb for EMEA customers?

elaine_security: I can take NovaGrid (KMS/HSM). Can someone link the HSM attestation doc? :eyes: 

sanjay_se: Leaving notes from recent Private deploy: config path is /opt/redwood/deploy/private/README (internal). Also sending a short snippet they can use: ```terraform
module "redwood_private" { region = "eu-west-1" kms_key_id = "<KMS-ID>" }
```

anna_cs: For MacroHealth, they asked about SOC2 + data residency. We have a template. Pinged legal to sign off on EEA-only data flow. :thumbsup: 

devon_ae: @maria_sales I'll own reaching out to MacroHealth PM at 10:30am PT, update here after call.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: docs-change detected in repo 'redwood-private': 'private-deploy/README.md' updated by sanjay_se — https://git.example/redwood/private/commit/abc123

maria_sales: Thanks. Elaine, any blockers on HSM attestation turnaround time?

elaine_security: Should be 48-72 hrs to prepare attestation packet. Need their KMS key fingerprint + contact for legal. If they want HSM on-prem, that's a different charge — billing should be looped in. @devon_ae please confirm.

devon_ae: Confirmed — will ask if they want managed KMS vs on-prem HSM. Also asking billing for quote on on-prem HSM.

maria_sales: Great. Anna, can you drop the SOC2 + residency template link here?

anna_cs: Here: https://confluence.redwood/internal/security/soc2-data-residency. Also attaching short checklist: - data processed in EEA only - KMS in eu-west-1 - logging enabled

sanjay_se: Quick note for SEs: if they need a private install we can provide a preflight script: ```./redwood_preflight.sh --verify-kms --check-network``` I'll DM the script to devon.

devon_ae: Got it. Thanks team — will update after MacroHealth call. If anyone hits blockers, flag me here. :rocket:
